program.name: Four-Day Legs
program.subject: Legs & glutes
program.blurb: Two leg days for every two upper days: quads, then glutes and hamstrings.
program.about: A four-day cycle with the legs split in two. The quad day is squats, lunges and step-ups; the back-of-the-legs day is deadlifts, hip thrusts and hamstring curls on the floor. An upper day follows each, so the legs get two days to recover. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
